name: Open Chest
description: A cracked oak chest sits crooked amid a pile of rubble. Whoever carried it this far didn't carry it any further.

name: Guardian Fight
description: The scrape of claws on stone echoes from a dark corner — something is guarding the treasure in this room, and it just caught your scent.
chainBuildupDescription: The scrape of claws on stone echoes from a dark corner — something is guarding the treasure in this room, and this time it doesn't look away.
chainForcedDescription: There's nowhere left to walk past this — the thing you kept avoiding has stopped waiting to be noticed.

reflection.prompt: The guardian's ashes still carry a trace of incense, not decay. Something tended this room, once.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: You didn't decide to fight this one. It decided you'd stalled long enough.

options.curious: Worth remembering — someone built this on purpose.
options.wary: Better not to think about who.

name: Merchant Encounter
description: A trembling oil lamp casts light on a cloth spread with strange wares — each one bears a spiral mark burned into it. A hooded figure bows in greeting, waving you closer.
returnDescription: The same hooded figure — or one just like it. The wares are new, but the bow is exactly as before.

reflection.prompt: The hooded figure never once lifted the hood, not even to count your coin.

options.curious: You find yourself wondering what's under there.
options.wary: You don't ask. Some things are better left covered.
options.dismissive: Not your business. You got what you came for.

name: Desecrate the Altar
description: The stone altar glows with a pale red light, pulsing as if breathing — touching it will surely wake whatever sleeps beneath.
chainBuildupDescription: The stone altar glows with a pale red light, pulsing as if breathing — touching it will surely wake whatever sleeps beneath, and it's been stirring since you walked past the last one.
chainForcedDescription: There's nowhere left to walk past this — the thing you kept avoiding has stopped waiting to be noticed.

reflection.prompt: The glow hasn't fully died down, even now. It's like the stone remembers being touched.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: This time you just ran out of room to keep avoiding it.

options.curious: Worth coming back for, once you know what you're looking for.
options.wary: Whatever's under there, you'd rather it stayed asleep.
options.dismissive: The glow's already fading. You've still got a floor left to clear.

name: Trade HP for an Artifact
description: Ancient carvings on the stone pedestal ooze a dark, still-warm liquid. It demands a price paid in blood, nothing more, nothing less.
chainEscalatedDescription: The stone recognizes the taste. It doesn't need to ask this time — it already knows you'll pay.

reflection.prompt: The wound closes faster than it should. The stone took exactly what it asked for, no more.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: The stone barely had to ask this time. That's the part that stays with you.

options.curious: That's precise, for a slab of rock — someone built it that way on purpose.
options.wary: Next time it might ask for more than skin.
options.dismissive: A fair price. You've paid worse for less.

name: Cursed Shrine
description: A statue with 3 eyes. One of them is open.

reflection.prompt: The open eye hasn't blinked once. You'd swear it's still watching, even from here.

options.curious: Three eyes, one open — you find yourself counting the shut ones on your way out.
options.wary: One open eye is already 1 too many for your taste.
options.dismissive: It's carved stone. Nothing's actually watching you.

name: Twin Altars
description: Two stone pedestals facing each other. Choose 1 — the other shatters the instant you touch its twin.

reflection.prompt: The shattered pedestal's dust hasn't settled. You didn't choose it, but it still feels like you broke something.

options.curious: What was on that one, you'll never know now.
options.dismissive: Rigged either way — not like you had a real choice.

name: Ritual Circle
description: Old dried blood stains the stone in a pattern too deliberate to be an accident. The circle doesn't accept ordinary offerings — only something already enchanted.
chainEscalatedDescription: The circle recognizes your hand before you kneel. It doesn't ask anymore.

reflection.prompt: The circle goes quiet again, the pattern in the blood no less deliberate than before. It didn't thank you. It didn't have to.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: You knelt before you'd even finished deciding to.

options.curious: That pattern wasn't drawn by accident, and you'd like to know by what.
options.wary: Not a place you'd want to visit more than you have to.
options.dismissive: A fair trade, and a better artifact for it. That's all it needs to be.

name: Wandering Gambling Den
description: A stranger shuffles 3 overturned cups, sneering in the dark — no brand on his skin, no altar in sight. 'Give me what you have. I'll double it, or keep it for good.'

returnDescription.won: The stranger deals a fresh hand without looking up. "Didn't expect a winner to come back for more."
returnDescription.lost: The stranger deals a fresh hand without looking up. "Back for more? I like watching the same face lose twice."
returnDescription.declined: The stranger deals a fresh hand without looking up. "Changed your mind, or just scared?"

reflection.prompt: The stranger's already shuffling for the next mark before you've finished walking away.

options.curious: You'd bet he's been doing this longer than the dungeon's been here.
options.wary: Not worth sticking around to find out what a 2nd losing streak costs you.
options.dismissive: A hustler's a hustler — nothing more mysterious than that.

name: Wandering Hermit
description: An old man sits meditating amid the rubble, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. 'I don't sell. I trade.'
returnDescription: The old man's eyes are already open, like he knew you'd be back. 'Trade again? I don't forget a fair deal.'

reflection.prompt: His eyes never opened again after the trade closed. You're not sure he needed them to.

options.curious: Whoever he used to be, before this — he's not telling, and you find yourself wanting to know.
options.wary: Some pasts are better left buried, not traded for.
options.dismissive: Strange old man, but he held up his end of it.

name: Collapsed Floor
description: One wrong step and you fall through to the floor below. A weak groan echoes up from the crack — someone else is still trapped down there.
